name: Rhiannon
bio: Archetype: Always Effective, Extra Round, AP Free, Skill Enhancement. ⌽ [All-Rounder] makes self count as every archetype tag. ⌽ Casts and enters an extra turn at turn start when at sufficient [Raptor Kinship] energy. ⌽ Deploys [Rapport] at turn start, increasing team afflatus advantage multiplier. ⌽ Charges [Raptor Kinship], and gains [Rapport] and 1 moxie at turn end. ⌽ Ultimate makes own incantations enter [Bendith] form and not consume AP, and increases allies' ATK/Max HP based on Rhiannon's ATK/Max HP. ⌽ S1 decreases all enemies' Crit DEF based on [Rapport] stacks when in [Bendith] form. ⌽ S2 increases Ult Might, Incantation Might, and Max HP on self, and increases team DMG Bonus based on [Rapport] when in [Bendith] form.
